generate_graph: generate a navigable graph from points and a pathfinder using habitat_sim shortest path checks
adjust_graph: adjust a navigation graph by removing invalid nodes and adding edges for specific replica scenes
visualize: visualize navigation points and graph edges as scatter plots with optional node index annotations
generate_replica_metadata: generate replica scene navigation graphs and pickle them for use in sound-spaces simulations
main: run the full pipeline to load metadata, generate graphs, visualize, and save for all replica scenes
